title: शो वितरणमा नेपाली हलहरू- पराईलाई काखा, आफ्नालाई पाखा !
content:
No ads found for this position काठमाडौं । अनमोल केसी स्टारर ‘बाटुलो जून’ ले हलहरुमा दर्शकको ठूलो उभार ल्याइरहेको छ । तर, यसका बाबजुद पनि सिनेमाघरहरुमा चाहेजति शो पाउन सकेको छैन । ‘आफ्नालाई पाखा र पराईलाई काखा’ को अनौठो सिद्धान्त पछ्याउँदै हलहरुले भारतीय चलचित्र ‘रामायण’ लाई काखी च्यापेर ‘बाटुलो जून’ प्रति पूर्वाग्रह देखाएका हुन् । नेपालकै सबैभन्दा ठूलो मल्टीप्लेक्स चेन क्युएफएक्सले भोलि शनिबारको लागि ‘रामायण’लाई ७० शो दिएको छ । जबकि ‘बाटुलो जून’ लाई जम्मा २९ शो मात्र दिएको छ । क्युएफएक्स चेन त एउटा उदाहरण मात्र हो । अन्य हलहरूले पनि ‘बाटुलो जून’ प्रति हेलोहोचो गरिरहेका छन् । यतिसम्म कि दरबार सिनेम्याक्सले ‘बाटुलो जून’ लाई जम्मा १ शो दिएर ‘रामायण’ लाई ८ शो जिम्मा लगाएको छ । हलहरूको यस्तो व्यवहारप्रति ‘बाटुलो जून’ का निर्माता सरोज न्यौपानेले सामाजिक संजालमै असन्तुष्टि पोखिसकेका छन् । उनले आफ्नै देशका हलहरुमा नेपाली चलचित्रलाई कहिलेसम्म अन्याय ? भन्दै प्रश्न गरेक हुन् । उनी लेख्छन्, ‘नेपाली चलचित्र उद्योगको विकास र प्रवर्द्धनमा महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका खेल्नुपर्ने चलचित्र हलहरूले नै नेपाली चलचित्रभन्दा हिन्दी चलचित्रलाई बढी प्राथमिकता दिनु कत्तिको न्यायसंगत हो ? नेपाली दर्शकहरूको माया र साथले उत्साहजनक यात्रा गरिरहेको ‘बाटुलो जून’ जस्तो चलचित्रलाई पर्याप्त शो नदिनु नेपाली चलचित्रकर्मीहरूको मेहनत, लगानी र सिर्जनाप्रतिको बेवास्ता होइन र ?’ न्यौपानेले थप लेखेका छन्, ‘हामी हिन्दी चलचित्रको विरोधमा छैनौँ । तर आफ्नै देशमा नेपाली चलचित्रले पनि न्यायोचित अवसर र सम्मान पाउनुपर्छ भन्ने हाम्रो माग हो ।’ नेपाली फिल्मलाई आफ्नै देशमा दोस्रो दर्जाको व्यवहार गरिनु हुन्न भन्ने उनको धारणा छ । बुझिएअनुसार भारतीय फिल्म ‘रामायण’ लाई एप्पल इन्टरटेनमेन्ट नामक वितरण कम्पनीले नेपालमा ल्याएको हो । यो वितरण कम्पनीमा क्युएफएक्स चेनका हल सञ्चालकहरुकै नाम जोडिने गर्छ । यद्यपि उनीहरुले सार्वजनिक रुपमा स्वीकार गरेका छैनन् । हलहरुको असमान शो वितरणबारे बुझ्नलाई चलचित्र संघका अध्यक्ष नरेन्द्र महर्जनलाई सम्पर्क गर्दा उनको फोन उठेन । हिजोबाट प्रदर्शनमा आएको अनमोल केसी स्टारर ‘बाटुलो जून’ले पहिलो दिनमा विष्फोटक ओपनिङ गरेको थियो । यसले सबैभन्दा ठूलो ओपनिङ गर्ने नन सिक्वैल चलचित्रको रेकर्ड बनाएको निर्माण पक्षको दाबी छ । रामायणको दबदबा चिर्दै चलचित्रले डेढ करोड हाराहारी कलेक्सन गर्न सफल भएको थियो । आज पनि ‘बाटुलो जून’ का अधिकांश शोहरु हाउसफुल नै छन् । तर, पर्याप्त शो नपाउँदा चलचित्रको व्यापार खुम्चिन सक्ने अवस्था देखिन्छ । Kathmandu. Anmol KC starrer 'Batulo June' is attracting a huge audience in the theaters. However, despite this, it has not been able to get as many shows in the theaters as it wanted. Following the strange principle of 'Afnalai Pakha and Parailai Kakha', the theaters have shown a bias towards 'Batulo Jun' by hugging the Indian film 'Ramayana'. Nepal's largest multiplex chain QFX has given 70 shows to 'Ramayana' for tomorrow, Saturday. While 'Batulo Jun' has been given only 29 shows. QFX chain is just one example. Other theaters are also giving a thumbs up to 'Batulo June'. So much so that Durbar Cinemax has given only 1 show to 'Batulo June' and 8 shows to 'Ramayana'. Saroj Neupane, the producer of 'Batulo June', has expressed his dissatisfaction on social media over this behavior of the theaters. He asked, "How long will Nepali films be treated unfairly in theaters in our own country?" He writes, "How fair is it that cinema halls, which should play an important role in the development and promotion of the Nepali film industry, give more priority to Hindi films than Nepali films? Isn't it a disregard for the hard work, investment, and creativity of Nepali filmmakers to not give adequate screening to a film like 'Batulo Jun', which is making an exciting journey with the love and support of Nepali audiences?" Neupane further wrote, 'We are not against Hindi films. But our demand is that Nepali films should also get fair opportunities and respect in our own country.' He believes that Nepali films should not be treated as second-class in their own country. It is understood that the Indian film 'Ramayana' was brought to Nepal by a distribution company called Apple Entertainment. The names of the hall operators of the QFX chain are often associated with this distribution company. However, they have not publicly admitted it. When I contacted the president of the Nepal Film Association, Narendra Maharjan, to inquire about the uneven distribution of shows in the theaters, his phone did not pick up. Anmol KC starrer 'Batulo June', which was released yesterday, had an explosive opening on the first day. The production side claims that it has set a record for the biggest opening for a non-sequel film. Breaking the dominance of Ramayana, the film managed to collect around 1.5 crores. Even today, most of the shows of 'Batulo June' are housefull. However, it seems that the film's business may shrink due to not getting enough shows.

नेपाली दर्शकहरूको माया र साथले उत्साहजनक यात्रा गरिरहेको ‘बाटुलो जून’ जस्तो चलचित्रलाई पर्याप्त शो नदिनु नेपाली चलचित्रकर्मीहरूको मेहनत, लगानी र सिर्जनाप्रतिको बेवास्ता होइन र ?’ न्यौपानेले थप लेखेका छन्, ‘हामी हिन्दी चलचित्रको विरोधमा छैनौँ । तर आफ्नै देशमा नेपाली चलचित्रले पनि न्यायोचित अवसर र सम्मान पाउनुपर्छ भन्ने हाम्रो माग हो ।’ नेपाली फिल्मलाई आफ्नै देशमा दोस्रो दर्जाको व्यवहार गरिनु हुन्न भन्ने उनको धारणा छ । बुझिएअनुसार भारतीय फिल्म ‘रामायण’ लाई एप्पल इन्टरटेनमेन्ट नामक वितरण कम्पनीले नेपालमा ल्याएको हो । यो वितरण कम्पनीमा क्युएफएक्स चेनका हल सञ्चालकहरुकै नाम जोडिने गर्छ । यद्यपि उनीहरुले सार्वजनिक रुपमा स्वीकार गरेका छैनन् । हलहरुको असमान शो वितरणबारे बुझ्नलाई चलचित्र संघका अध्यक्ष नरेन्द्र महर्जनलाई सम्पर्क गर्दा उनको फोन उठेन । हिजोबाट प्रदर्शनमा आएको अनमोल केसी स्टारर ‘बाटुलो जून’ले पहिलो दिनमा विष्फोटक ओपनिङ गरेको थियो । यसले सबैभन्दा ठूलो ओपनिङ गर्ने नन सिक्वैल चलचित्रको रेकर्ड बनाएको निर्माण पक्षको दाबी छ । रामायणको दबदबा चिर्दै चलचित्रले डेढ करोड हाराहारी कलेक्सन गर्न सफल भएको थियो । आज पनि ‘बाटुलो जून’ का अधिकांश शोहरु हाउसफुल नै छन् । तर, पर्याप्त शो नपाउँदा चलचित्रको व्यापार खुम्चिन सक्ने अवस्था देखिन्छ । Kathmandu. Anmol KC starrer 'Batulo June' is attracting a huge audience in the theaters. However, despite this, it has not been able to get as many shows in the theaters as it wanted. Following the strange principle of 'Afnalai Pakha and Parailai Kakha', the theaters have shown a bias towards 'Batulo Jun' by hugging the Indian film 'Ramayana'. Nepal's largest multiplex chain QFX has given 70 shows to 'Ramayana' for tomorrow, Saturday. While 'Batulo Jun' has been given only 29 shows. QFX chain is just one example. Other theaters are also giving a thumbs up to 'Batulo June'. So much so that Durbar Cinemax has given only 1 show to 'Batulo June' and 8 shows to 'Ramayana'. Saroj Neupane, the producer of 'Batulo June', has expressed his dissatisfaction on social media over this behavior of the theaters. He asked, "How long will Nepali films be treated unfairly in theaters in our own country?" He writes, "How fair is it that cinema halls, which should play an important role in the development and promotion of the Nepali film industry, give more priority to Hindi films than Nepali films? Isn't it a disregard for the hard work, investment, and creativity of Nepali filmmakers to not give adequate screening to a film like 'Batulo Jun', which is making an exciting journey with the love and support of Nepali audiences?" Neupane further wrote, 'We are not against Hindi films. But our demand is that Nepali films should also get fair opportunities and respect in our own country.' He believes that Nepali films should not be treated as second-class in their own country. It is understood that the Indian film 'Ramayana' was brought to Nepal by a distribution company called Apple Entertainment. The names of the hall operators of the QFX chain are often associated with this distribution company. However, they have not publicly admitted it. When I contacted the president of the Nepal Film Association, Narendra Maharjan, to inquire about the uneven distribution of shows in the theaters, his phone did not pick up. Anmol KC starrer 'Batulo June', which was released yesterday, had an explosive opening on the first day. The production side claims that it has set a record for the biggest opening for a non-sequel film. Breaking the dominance of Ramayana, the film managed to collect around 1.5 crores. Even today, most of the shows of 'Batulo June' are housefull. However, it seems that the film's business may shrink due to not getting enough shows.

Anmol KC starrer 'Batulo June' is attracting a huge audience in the theaters. However, despite this, it has not been able to get as many shows in the theaters as it wanted. Following the strange principle of 'Afnalai Pakha and Parailai Kakha', the theaters have shown a bias towards 'Batulo Jun' by hugging the Indian film 'Ramayana'. Nepal's largest multiplex chain QFX has given 70 shows to 'Ramayana' for tomorrow, Saturday. While 'Batulo Jun' has been given only 29 shows. QFX chain is just one example. Other theaters are also giving a thumbs up to 'Batulo June'. So much so that Durbar Cinemax has given only 1 show to 'Batulo June' and 8 shows to 'Ramayana'. Saroj Neupane, the producer of 'Batulo June', has expressed his dissatisfaction on social media over this behavior of the theaters. He asked, "How long will Nepali films be treated unfairly in theaters in our own country?" He writes, "How fair is it that cinema halls, which should play an important role in the development and promotion of the Nepali film industry, give more priority to Hindi films than Nepali films? Isn't it a disregard for the hard work, investment, and creativity of Nepali filmmakers to not give adequate screening to a film like 'Batulo Jun', which is making an exciting journey with the love and support of Nepali audiences?" Neupane further wrote, 'We are not against Hindi films. But our demand is that Nepali films should also get fair opportunities and respect in our own country.' He believes that Nepali films should not be treated as second-class in their own country. It is understood that the Indian film 'Ramayana' was brought to Nepal by a distribution company called Apple Entertainment. The names of the hall operators of the QFX chain are often associated with this distribution company. However, they have not publicly admitted it. When I contacted the president of the Nepal Film Association, Narendra Maharjan, to inquire about the uneven distribution of shows in the theaters, his phone did not pick up. Anmol KC starrer 'Batulo June', which was released yesterday, had an explosive opening on the first day. The production side claims that it has set a record for the biggest opening for a non-sequel film. Breaking the dominance of Ramayana, the film managed to collect around 1.5 crores. Even today, most of the shows of 'Batulo June' are housefull. However, it seems that the film's business may shrink due to not getting enough shows.
